title: 2024 Topps ASG All Star Game Foil #401 LA Dodgers Lineup Stays Dangerous
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Capture a piece of baseball history with the 2024 Topps ASG All-Star Game Foil #401, featuring the dynamic duo of Freddie Freeman and Mookie Betts, the Dodgers Lineup Stays Dangerous. As part of the esteemed 2024 Topps All-Star Game series, this card is a must-have for collectors and fans alike, showcasing the talent and prowess of these MLB stars.

This exclusive sports trading card is a shining example of Topps' craftsmanship, with its striking parallel/variety design. It's a base set card that doesn't carry an autograph, ensuring the focus remains on the players' legacy and the card's design. Whether you're a Dodgers enthusiast or a connoisseur of the All-Star Game memorabilia, this card is a standout addition to any collection.
